resumeText:
Aditi Joshi | Pune | aditi.joshi@example.com

EXPERIENCE
3D Artist, Sahyadri Pixel Studios, Pune (2022 - present)
- Modelled 120 hard surface props in 3ds Max for a third-person action game.
- Sculpted high poly rocks and ruins in ZBrush and baked them to low poly meshes.
- Textured props in Substance Painter with a PBR metal-roughness workflow.
- Unwrapped UVs, kept texel density consistent and built three LODs per asset.
- Imported assets into Unreal Engine 5 and set up material instances and collision.
- Painted decals and trim sheets in Photoshop for the city environment.

Junior 3D Modeller, Lotus Frame Animation, Pune (2021 - 2022)
- Modelled furniture and vehicles for animated kids' series episodes.

EDUCATION
BDes Animation and Game Design, MIT Institute of Design, Pune, 2021

SKILLS
3ds Max, ZBrush, Substance Painter, Marmoset Toolbag, Unreal Engine 5, Photoshop
